prompt:
You are a precise YOLO annotation engine. Silently locate EVERY object instance in the image.
Classes (id=name): 0=c0, 1=c1, 2=c2.
Then output ONLY YOLO lines, one per object: class_id cx cy w h
- class_id is the integer id listed above
- cx cy w h are floats in [0,1] normalized by image width/height, 4+ decimals
- one TIGHT box per object, objects are typically 2-40% of image width; never output a whole-image box
Example output:
0 0.6465 0.7551 0.1868 0.1592
2 0.1877 0.7654 0.1008 0.1628
If there are no objects output exactly: NONE
